title: Domain-fingerprint-driven calibration batches for INT8/FP8 accuracy validation
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Goal: create a reproducible, per-domain calibration dataset generation and sampling strategy that produces small, representative 'calibration batches' for INT8 and FP8 quantization calibration and downstream accuracy validation. Approach centers on computing a compact domain fingerprint (embedding + metadata histogram) for each production workload slice and using that fingerprint to drive stratified exemplar selection and tail-sample oversampling. This ticket covers design, pipeline implementation, and initial validation for two runtimes (v1 kernel stack for INT8 and experimental FP8 path).
background_and_motivation: We currently use broad calibration packs that overrepresent frequent short prompts and underrepresent long-tail domain behaviors. For production quantization (INT8/FP8) we need small per-domain packs that: (1) capture prompt diversity and token-length distribution, (2) keep quant-calibration cost low, and (3) surface accuracy regressions for critical user-facing intents. Domain fingerprints let us automatically group related prompts and derive pack composition rules instead of hand-curated domain lists.
acceptance_criteria: Per-domain calibration packs generated by pipeline for at least 12 product domains
Coverage: >90% of domain intent clusters have at least 3 exemplar prompts in the pack

Accuracy regression detection: quantized model delta perplexity and top-1 token accuracy must be within thresholds on calibration packs; detection configured for >0.8 probability of true positive for regressions >1.5% token-accuracy degradation
Pack size: default packs under 10k tokens and adjustable by domain risk profile
End-to-end reproducible pipeline with checklists and data lineage logging, dataset stored at s3://redwood-calibration/domain-packs/v1/
Integration test run that compares float32 vs INT8/FP8 on all packs and uploads metrics to console-qa dashboard
high_level_design: 1) Ingest production prompts stream and metadata (route, product, customer tier, region). 2) Compute prompt embeddings with the canonical evaluation model (embedding-v2). 3) Cluster embeddings per domain using HDBSCAN to identify sub-intents. 4) Compute a domain fingerprint vector: [intent cluster histogram, token-length distribution quantiles, response length mean, prefix entropy, time-of-day histogram]. 5) For each domain, derive pack composition rules: stratified selection across intent clusters, tail-weighted oversample of rare long prompts, and canonical prompt normalization rules for anonymization. 6) Export packs along with provenance and sampling seeds for reproducibility.
detailed_steps: Write ingestion ETL that pulls last 90 days of anonymized prompts and metadata
Compute embeddings nightly using embedding-v2 and cache outputs
Cluster per-domain with HDBSCAN and label clusters with auto-extracted intent tags
Calculate fingerprint features and store vectors in feature-store (S3 parquet + index)
Implement sampler: stratified by cluster with weights = max(cluster_freq, alpha * tail_score) where alpha tuned per domain
Implement size heuristics: pack_token_budget(domain) = base_budget * risk_multiplier(domain)
Add anonymization pipeline: PII redaction, canonicalization, token-length-preserving masking
Export packs and a deterministic manifest (seed, sampling params)
sampling_algorithm_notes: We use a two-stage sampler. First stage: stratified sample across intent clusters proportional to cluster importance but clipped to ensure at least min_examples_per_cluster. Second stage: within cluster, score prompts by tailness = (1 - cluster_rank_freq) * normalized_token_length^beta * response_entropy, then sample top-k with replacement allowed for very rare tails. Beta defaults to 1.2 for INT8 (favor longer prompts) and 0.9 for FP8 (favor diverse entropy). Seeds are recorded to recreate packs exactly.
metrics_and_validation: Per-pack metrics: token_count, unique_users_pct, cluster_coverage_pct, mean_token_length, max_token_length
Quant eval metrics: token-level accuracy delta vs float, perplexity ratio, logit KL divergence per-position
Alert thresholds: token-accuracy drop >1.0% flagged; mean logit KL >0.02 flagged
Statistical tests: bootstrap CI for token-accuracy delta; ensure CI excludes 0 for regression detection
Monitoring: time-series of metric deltas in console-qa with per-domain long-term baselines
experiments: A/B sampling: compare uniform cluster sampling vs domain-fingerprint stratified sampling on holdout domains (4-week run)
Pack sizing ablation: evaluate 2k, 5k, 10k token packs and measure regression detection sensitivity
Beta FP8 run: calibrate FP8 kernels with domain packs and compare delta distributions to INT8 baseline
risks_and_mitigation: PII leakage during ingestion: mitigation = enforce PII redaction step and run differential privacy checks on samples
Overfitting calibration to historical prompts: mitigation = include a freshness weight and reserve 20% of recent prompts for validation
Clustering instability across embedding version changes: mitigation = store cluster seeds, lock embedding model for a pack version, and run migration comparison when upgrading embeddings
implementation_timeline: Week 4: quant-eval harness + upload metrics to console-qa
Week 5: run experiments and finalize pack v1
rollout_plan: Generate packs for 12 priority domains and publish to s3 under v1
Run quant-eval for INT8/FP8 against float baseline and review with Applied ML and Runtime
If no critical regressions, enable routine quant-validation job in CI and add pack generation to nightly pipeline
Postmortem and adjustments after first month of monitoring
qa_and_operator_checks: Reproducibility check: re-run sampler with saved seed and assert identical pack manifest
Sanity checks: token budget constraints, PII scan passed, and cluster coverage thresholds
Performance: pack generation completes under 2 hours for 90-day window
next_steps: Review design with Applied ML team (meeting scheduled 2025-02-20)
Start ETL implementation and provide first draft of fingerprint vectors by 2025-02-17
Coordinate with Runtime team to enable FP8 evaluation binary on CI
notes: We intentionally separate domain fingerprint from product domain declaration so that teams with cross-product flows get appropriate pack membership.
This ticket focuses on pack curation; downstream model calibration loop (autocal) will consume these packs via ENG-32010.
Calibration manifests must include sampling seed, embed-version, cluster-hyperparams for auditability
